name: Azeroth Companion
title: Sovereign Tree Overhaul — Ascendant Visual Foundation
features: Optional Ascendant View turns Talent Atlas into an original dark-fantasy progression map with a single toggle.
Choice, multi-rank and highly connected talent nodes receive distinct visual styling based on source-backed structure, not fabricated rarity or unlock tiers.
Blizzard-reported connections now visually distinguish planned gold pathways and partially planned cyan routes.
Compact source-aware status HUD, small expandable node legend, and refined Radiant Warrior canvas styling improve legibility.
Existing tree positions, source IDs, allocations, rank preview, full-screen mode, zoom, minimap, saves, Media Studio and account integrations remain unchanged.
